nodes.label: words.details as the single source of word enrichment (page + tutor)
nodes.rationale: Reused the existing items_list dynamic variable instead of adding a new ElevenLabs dynamic variable, because declaring a new placeholder in sync-agents.ts would change every agent's config hash and force a re-sync of all prompt versions for no benefit. Kept register/nuance notes out of the stored payload (fact/nuance split): curated data pins enumerable facts the model hallucinates on; the tutor still generates conversational nuance live.
